items.title: Fanny, Blade of Kibou
items.alt: Fanny with orange hair in a high ponytail leaps through a bright blue sky with a thin blade in each hand and a glass city behind her.
items.line: Fanny leaps across the bright city sky with a blade in each hand.

facts.source: Skin release date, official Mobile Legends: Bang Bang Instagram post

items.title: Layla, Miss Hikari
items.alt: Layla with long pink twin tails kneels behind a long white cannon while a round black droid with a cyan face floats in the foreground.
items.line: Layla kneels behind her long white cannon, her round black droid close beside her.

facts.source: Skin release date, official Mobile Legends: Bang Bang Instagram post

items.title: Fanny and Layla, fighting together
items.alt: Layla with pink twin tails swings a huge white cannon across the frame while Fanny with orange hair dives in beside her, in a bright city of glass towers.
items.line: Layla and Fanny strike side by side above a bright city.

items.title: Fanny and Layla, key art
items.alt: Fanny and Layla leap through a bright sky with a long blade between them and the Aspirants logo at the top left.
items.line: Fanny and Layla leap through a bright sky with a long blade between them.

facts.source: Same art with banner text, official Mobile Legends: Bang Bang Instagram post

items.title: Fanny and Layla, blue sky
items.alt: Fanny and Layla stand together under a blue sky with white clouds and a city behind them.
items.line: Fanny and Layla stand side by side under a bright blue sky.

items.title: Ruby, Mecha Maiden
items.alt: Ruby with dark hair and pink ends swings a huge white and orange blade over a blue night city, with dark machine hands reaching in from the right.
items.line: Ruby swings her huge white and orange blade over a blue city at night.

facts.source: Skin release date, official Mobile Legends: Bang Bang Instagram post

items.title: Angela, Cyber Cherubin
items.alt: Angela with peach pink twin tails and large pink and white rabbit ear headphones sits in a sunny rest area at 8:31 AM, with a small chibi companion, a floating drone and a cup of bubble tea.
items.line: Angela sits in a sunny rest area with a tiny companion and a floating drone.

facts.source: Skin release date, official Mobile Legends: Bang Bang Instagram post

items.title: Lesley, Deadeye Spectre
items.alt: Lesley with long blonde hair dives through the air above a pale city, aiming an orange and gold cannon with a large red and orange wing module behind her.
items.line: Lesley dives above a pale city with her sniper cannon and its wing module open.

facts.source: Skin release date, official Mobile Legends: Bang Bang Instagram post

items.title: Chang'e, Tech Tensai
items.alt: Chang'e with pink twin tails, a green streak, round glasses and rabbit ears reaches out from a white mecha in front of a glowing blue ring, with a city and distant flying shapes behind her.
items.line: Chang'e reaches out from her rabbit eared mecha in front of a glowing ring.

facts.source: Skin release date, official Mobile Legends: Bang Bang Instagram post

items.title: Guinevere, Daybreak Halo
items.alt: Guinevere with long pale hair that fades to violet and a red bow leaps through the sky with gold star blades, round droids and glowing red crystals around her.
items.line: Guinevere leaps through the clouds with her star blades, round droids and red crystals around her.

facts.source: Skin release date, official Mobile Legends: Bang Bang Instagram post

items.title: Guinevere raises a fist
items.alt: Guinevere raises one fist in a burst of colored rays, with two white droids and orange gloves floating around her.
items.line: Guinevere raises a fist in a burst of colored rays, with her white droids around her.

items.title: Vexana, Twilight Star
items.alt: Vexana with silver blue hair stands on a rooftop at night in front of a huge dark mecha that holds a giant violet sword.
items.line: Vexana stands on a night rooftop with a huge dark mecha and its giant sword behind her.

facts.source: Skin release date, official Mobile Legends: Bang Bang Instagram post

items.title: Guinevere and Vexana, splash art
items.alt: Vexana's face in profile fills the left of the frame in pale violet light, while Guinevere flies toward the right and small figures fight in the distance.
items.line: Vexana's face fills the left in pale light while Guinevere flies away to the right.

items.title: Guinevere and Vexana, fighting moment
items.alt: Vexana lunges with a dark spear at the left while Guinevere reaches out at the upper right, both under a dark spiked crown of violet energy.
items.line: Vexana and Guinevere rush forward together under a dark crown of violet energy.

items.title: Guinevere and Vexana, fighting stance
items.alt: Vexana in white and violet stands at the left and Guinevere in red and gold floats at the right with her droids, in front of a dark violet storm.
items.line: Vexana and Guinevere stand ready in a dark violet storm.

items.title: Selena, Silverbolt Raiko
items.alt: Selena with long golden hair and small horns flies forward with a grin in a blue and silver mecha suit, with small chibi faces floating in the corners.
items.line: Selena flies forward with a grin, her blue and silver mecha at her side.

facts.source: Skin release date, official Mobile Legends: Bang Bang Instagram post
